levels.label: Behavior evidence states
levels.allowed_claim: A local manifest can distinguish verified, execution-only, failed, and missing behavior evidence.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every behavior or runtime path is covered.

levels.label: Stale evidence
levels.allowed_claim: A target mismatch marks historical results stale instead of treating them as current proof.
levels.forbidden_inference: The stale receipt has been rerun or refreshed.

levels.label: Current dev checkpoint
levels.status_display: Fresh/stale matrix and checks reproduce on dev
levels.allowed_claim: The current dev head passes its local checks and reproduces verified, execution-only, failed, unknown, duplicate, and stale behavior states.
levels.forbidden_inference: The current dev head has complete runtime or Review Attention Map coverage.

levels.label: Review handoff
levels.allowed_claim: The receipt leaves an explicit seam for a source-and-freshness review handoff.
levels.forbidden_inference: Review Attention Map has consumed this exact receipt.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The atlas case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
